protocol.on_classifier_fallback: flag separately; exclude from Jev-only summary; do not silently label heuristic as Jev
protocol.on_decline: record adaptive refusal and still collect both baseline answers
protocol.on_model_error: record failure; do not silently substitute another model
protocol.on_scoring: use frozen references; deterministic year/date checks where possible; blind model identity for rubric grading; human-adjudicate disagreements
protocol.accuracy_definition: primary: proportion rubric score=4; also report score>=3 and mean 0-4 score
protocol.secondary_subset: report the remaining 66 cases as overlap-not-detected; this is not a clean location holdout
protocol.training_policy: do not rebuild the registry, train predictors or tune on MEI results during this benchmark
protocol.runner_integration: call scripts.verify_mapevolve_freeze.load_frozen(); stock comparison UI and offline evaluator do not enforce this protocol
protocol.judge_policy: freeze judge prompt; choose and record judge model before grading; if GPT-5.1 grades GPT-5.1 outputs, report self-judge bias
protocol.key_validation: all three required key variables present, no duplicate assignments; authentication/billing not tested

cost_limit_scope: Known answer and judge costs only; TypeSafe billing not exposed by this code.
